messages:
Ivy: FYI a handful of customers reported billing owner mismatch after our rotation rollout. Not a full outage but confusing in Console.

Luca: Can you paste a minimal trace?

Ivy: Sure:
Request-ID: r-77
X-Api-Key: key-prev-7f
X-Effective-Principal: sa:proj-14:worker
Rotation-ID: rot-1854
Billing export: owner=sa:proj-14:worker (new)

Fern: Looks like timing again. Proposal: add a short rotation_grace window (30s) where gateway attributes using a deterministic inference service that joins key->rotation events and prefers the rotation-side owner when ambiguous.

Luca: So gateway would call billing-inference service synchronously? Concern about added latency.

Fern: Not a sync call. We'll embed a small in-process cache populated by rotation events. On key validation, if a rotation happened <30s ago, we mark billing_owner_inferred and set a low-cardinality owner_bucket tag. The inference service runs asynchronously to reconcile.

Ivy: UX: Console should show Owner (inferred) badge when that flag is set and link to mapping. Full SA only in support logs.

Luca: Telemetry: emit owner_bucket, rotation_recent=true/false, and key_hash. Avoid raw SA in metrics. Add rotation_noise alert when inferred-owner ratio > 0.5% for an org over 1h.

meter-bot: Alert rule updated in staging: rotation_noise.org.rate > 0.5% (1h) -> slack #eng-oncall.

Fern: Rollout plan: rotation-service will emit rotation_event with owner bucket and rotation_id. Gateway consumes and updates cache. Console gets new badge behind flag console.show_inferred_owner=false. Canary 10% traffic for 48h.

Ivy: Also need a small support helper page which explains inferred owner and how to query raw logs with rotation_id, will author /docs/support/inferred-billing.md.

Luca: Add unit tests for cache TTL and a perf microbenchmark. If latency impact >5ms p50 we need to rework to purely async tagging.

Ivy: OK will assemble checklist: rotation events, cache, metric tags, console badge, support doc, alert. I'll post PR links here.

Fern: Thanks. If staging looks good we flip flag and shorten grace to 10s based on data.

Ivy: Sounds good — moving to canary.
